audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Jax, Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Jax, K'Sante, K'Sante, contradicting its own whys on four rows: whys[0] opens 'K'Sante owns level 1', whys[2] says your full combo wins the extended trade, whys[3] calls Levels 4-5 a skill window, whys[5] says 'Both spike here'.
audit.why: Level 3 is the page's stated flip point and the chart gave it to K'Sante; Level 1 was given to Jax in direct contradiction of the sentence beneath it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 = K'Sante, 2 = Jax, 3 = Skill, 5 = Skill, matching the packet chart and the whys, ratings moved to match. One atomic group across both layers; rows 1, 4, 6 already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers, and the page framed All Out as something you can wait out.
audit.why: All Out is 120s at rank 1 — a genuinely huge window if he uses it and misses. Path Maker is 14s, Footwork 10s, and Ntofo Strikes is a flat 3.5s at every rank, which is why his poke never stops and why waiting for 'his cooldowns' as a group never happens.
audit.corrected: All four numbers plus Counter Strike's 17s written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] said only 'trade when All Out is down'. Two ability facts were also misattributed: dosFull[1]/dontsFull[0] blame the wall knock-up on his Q, and wants.foe[1] says the shockwave fires on the third cast.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit and fires the pulling shockwave at 2 stacks, not 3. The wall displacement is All Out (R), which launches you through any wall in your path. And the decisive interaction is Path Maker: he takes reduced damage during its charge-up, so a Counter Strike stun or Empower released into the brace is wasted.
audit.corrected: report[5] rewritten around baiting Path Maker and the All Out wall throw; wants.foe[1] corrected to 2 stacks; dosFull[1].d given Ntofo Strikes' real 450 range and 3.5s cooldown; dontsFull[0].d corrected to name All Out as the wall throw.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and early state that K'Sante's passive 'adds percent-HP' to his hits.
audit.why: Riot's description of Dauntless Instinct says his abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next attack — it does not describe percent-health damage. Asserting a percent-HP passive changes how a player builds and is not supported by the kit.
audit.corrected: whys[0] rewritten to describe the passive as Riot does — a mark that makes his next hit hurt more.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Trade when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - All Out: 120s at rank 1 — his whole duel. - Path Maker: 14s, the brace that eats your stun. - Footwork: 10s shield-dash out. - Ntofo Strikes: 3.5s, so the poke never stops. - Counter Strike: 17s.

edits.before: Track K'Sante's All Out: His duelist mode. Trade when it’s down. When it is down — Q-E-W him.
edits.after: Path Maker's charge-up eats your stun — bait that W; All Out knocks you through a wall.

edits.before: Hold E until K'Sante commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: Ntofo Strikes is a 450-range line on 3.5s; at 2 stacks it shockwaves and pulls you in — stay out.

edits.before: That is K'Sante's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: It is All Out, not Ntofo Strikes, that throws you through a wall — hug open ground.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: All Out trades his tank stats for damage and healing — disengage.

edits.before: K'Sante owns level 1 — his Path Maker brace shrugs your one committed auto through damage reduction and his passive adds percent-HP, while you have only Leap Strike and no Counter Strike to punish him yet.
edits.after: K'Sante owns level 1 — Path Maker's charge-up shrugs your one committed auto through damage reduction, and his passive marks you for bonus damage on his next hit, while you hold only Leap Strike.

edits.before: Stack Ntofo Strikes (Q) — land the third-cast shockwave to drag you in, and grind your HP with his percent-HP passive on every auto
edits.after: Stack Ntofo Strikes (Q) — the second stack fires a shockwave that drags you in, then grind you down with his passive-marked autos

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Hold Counter Strike' — FALSE POSITIVE, that is Jax's own E and the kit confirms the name. dosFull[1].t still reads 'Dodge his Q wall-knockups' and dontsFull[0].t 'Get walled by his Q'; both misattribute the wall throw to Ntofo Strikes when it is All Out. Their titles are short enough that the applier's 25-character skip may drop a title-only edit, so I corrected the misattribution inside the descriptions instead — the titles should be retitled by hand if a later pass can carry them. UNVERIFIED: report[8]'s Executioner's Calling line — All Out does grant healing per the kit, so anti-heal is defensible, but the exact timing was not checkable from the kit.
